svg.title: Where the track is today
svg.desc: Top-down cartoon map of today. A dirt road leads from Your app past the wooden Gate and Router. After the router, Rust track runs alongside the old dirt road. Customs is a finished Rust station built right over the track. Cache, Vault and Post office have construction sites on the track while their old wooden stations still sit off to the side. The Ledger is wooden. A Rust train is stopped at the Cache, where crabs unload its crates onto a wagon headed up the side road. After the stations, the OCR line is Rust track, Messages is opt-in Rust track, and Responses and Chat are still dirt roads.
svg.text: Rust track runs past the router, but most stations are still Python, so the train stops and unloads at each one.
